name: Zhu Xi
shortBio: Song dynasty Neo-Confucian master whose synthesis of rational Principle (li) and vital material force (qi) codified the Four Books and dominated East Asian metaphysics, ethics, and civil examination culture for seven centuries.
centralQuestion: How do the timeless normative coherence of Principle (li) and the dynamic materiality of Vital Force (qi) unite in human nature and moral self-cultivation?

keyWorks.title: Commentaries on the Four Books (Sishu Zhangju Jizhu)
keyWorks.description: Authoritative Neo-Confucian synthesis organizing the Analects, Mencius, Great Learning, and Doctrine of the Mean.

keyWorks.title: Reflections on Things at Hand (Jinsi Lu)
keyWorks.description: Systematic anthology of Song Neo-Confucian metaphysics, investigation of things (gewu), and moral self-cultivation.
